Overjoyed about purchasing Chandiramani's flat, Sodhi takes Bhide to a two-wheeler showroom and forcefully gifts him a brand-new ₹83,000 motorcycle in place of a brokerage commission. Sodhi and Roshan celebrate buying the flat to accommodate visiting relatives from Punjab.
